messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Synthetic Process 6. New cases arrive every 17.0 minutes on average (exponential inter-arrival). Steps:
1. Process case 0 - service task, uniform 8.0-14.0 min, performed by Worker 2.
After 'Process case 0', an exclusive decision routes 76% to 'Assess claim 1' and the rest to 'Register case 2'.
2. Assess claim 1 - service task, fixed 2.0 minutes, performed by Worker 2.
3. Register case 2 - service task, normal mean 22.0 min std 4.0 min, performed by Worker 2.
4. Assess form 3 - service task, exponential mean 18.0 min, performed by Worker 1.
5. Schedule form 4 - service task, fixed 6.0 minutes, performed by Worker 2.
The process then ends. Simulate for 8 hours.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:bpsim="http://www.bpsim.org/schemas/1.0"

                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">
  
  <!-- Process Definition -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Case Arrived">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Case0</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    
    <!-- Step 1: Process case 0 -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessCase0" name="Process case 0">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Case0</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Case0_To_XOR</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    
    <!-- Exclusive Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_XOR1" name="Routing Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Case0_To_XOR</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_XOR_To_AssessClaim1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_XOR_To_RegisterCase2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Step 2: Assess claim 1 -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssessClaim1" name="Assess claim 1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_XOR_To_AssessClaim1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessClaim1_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    
    <!-- Step 3: Register case 2 -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterCase2" name="Register case 2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_XOR_To_RegisterCase2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterCase2_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    
    <!-- Inclusive/Exclusive Join for Path Convergence -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_XOR2" name="Merge Paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessClaim1_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterCase2_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Step 4: Assess form 3 -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssessForm3" name="Assess form 3">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_To_AssessForm3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessForm3_To_ScheduleForm4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    
    <!-- Step 5: Schedule form 4 -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ScheduleForm4" name="Schedule form 4">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessForm3_To_ScheduleForm4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ScheduleForm4_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    
    <!-- End Event -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ScheduleForm4_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Case0" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ProcessCase0" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Case0_To_XOR" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCase0" targetRef="Gateway_XOR1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_XOR_To_AssessClaim1" name="76%" sourceRef="Gateway_XOR1" targetRef="Task_AssessClaim1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_XOR_To_RegisterCase2" name="24%" sourceRef="Gateway_XOR1" targetRef="Task_RegisterCase2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessClaim1_To_AssessForm3" sourceRef="Task_AssessClaim1" targetRef="Gateway_XOR2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterCase2_To_AssessForm3" sourceRef="Task_RegisterCase2" targetRef="Gateway_XOR2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_To_AssessForm3" sourceRef="Gateway_XOR2" targetRef="Task_AssessForm3" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessForm3_To_ScheduleForm4" sourceRef="Task_AssessForm3" targetRef="Task_ScheduleForm4" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ScheduleForm4_To_End" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleForm4" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
    
  </bpmn:process>
  
  <!-- BPSim Simulation Configuration -->
  <bpmn:relationship type="BPSimData">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpsim:BPSimData>
        <bpsim:Scenario id="Scenario_1" name="8-Hour Simulation Scenario">
          <bpsim:ScenarioParameters duration="PT8H" timeUnit="min" />
          
          <!-- Resource Definitions -->
          <bpsim:Resource id="Resource_Worker1" name="Worker 1" capacity="1" />
          <bpsim:Resource id="Resource_Worker2" name="Worker 2" capacity="1" />
          
          <!-- Element Parameters -->
          
          <!-- Start Event: Exponential inter-arrival mean 17.0 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="StartEvent_1">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:WaitTime>
                <bpsim:ExponentialDistribution mean="17.0" />
              </bpsim:WaitTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Task 0: Process case 0 (Worker 2, Uniform 8.0 - 14.0 min) -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Task_ProcessCase0">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:UniformDistribution min="8.0" max="14.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:ResourceRef>Resource_Worker2</bpsim:ResourceRef>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Routing Probabilities -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Flow_XOR_To_AssessClaim1">
            <bpsim:ControlParameters>
              <bpsim:Probability>0.76</bpsim:Probability>
            </bpsim:ControlParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Flow_XOR_To_RegisterCase2">
            <bpsim:ControlParameters>
              <bpsim:Probability>0.24</bpsim:Probability>
            </bpsim:ControlParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Task 1: Assess claim 1 (Worker 2, Fixed 2.0 min) -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Task_AssessClaim1">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:ConstantDistribution value="2.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:ResourceRef>Resource_Worker2</bpsim:ResourceRef>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Task 2: Register case 2 (Worker 2, Normal mean 22.0 min, std 4.0 min) -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Task_RegisterCase2">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:NormalDistribution mean="22.0" standardDeviation="4.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:ResourceRef>Resource_Worker2</bpsim:ResourceRef>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Task 3: Assess form 3 (Worker 1, Exponential mean 18.0 min) -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Task_AssessForm3">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:ExponentialDistribution mean="18.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:ResourceRef>Resource_Worker1</bpsim:ResourceRef>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
          <!-- Task 4: Schedule form 4 (Worker 2, Fixed 6.0 min) -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters targetRef="Task_ScheduleForm4">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:ConstantDistribution value="6.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:ResourceRef>Resource_Worker2</bpsim:ResourceRef>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>
          
        </bpsim:Scenario>
      </bpsim:BPSimData>
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:relationship>
```
